entities.name: Ironhold
entities.description: Major city and fortress of the Iron Kingdom on Corondor, formerly Gan.

entities.name: Trine
entities.description: Fallen angel who destroyed the people of Gan.

entities.name: Mandek Ironfist
entities.description: Warlord who ordered Gan's destruction and founded the Iron Kingdom.

entities.name: Rahel
entities.description: Trine's former sister who killed her.

events.summary: Trine destroyed all Ganarians of Gan on Mandek's orders.
events.quote: all living 100,457 Ganarians of Gan were destroyed by the fallen angel Trine

events.summary: Mandek took over the city and founded the Iron Kingdom, renaming it Ironhold.
events.quote: Mandek took over the city and founded the Iron Kingdom centered there

events.summary: Rahel killed Trine and absolved her.
events.quote: the fallen angel was killed by her former sister, Rahel

relations.quote: the fallen angel was killed by her former sister, Rahel
